jobs.description:
## IN KÜRZE

Du liebst es, auf zwei Rädern durch die Stadt zu cruisen und Menschen den Tag mit gutem Kaffee zu versorgen? Als Gavetti Velo-Kurier*in (ab sofort, 60%) in Zürich bist du das Gesicht von FELFEL vor Ort und sorgst selbstständig dafür, dass unsere Firmenkunden täglich perfekten Kaffeegenuss erleben .

Du besuchst ca. 7-8 Firmenkunden am Tag, schaust vor Ort, ob mit der Gavetti (Kaffeemaschine) alles i.O. ist, füllst die nötigen Materialien wie Milch, Kaffeebohnen, Tee und Zucker auf. Zudem führst du bei jeder Maschine eine Reinigung durch und gehst währenddessen auf Kundenfeedback ein. Nach deinem Besuch sollte die Gavetti einladend und sauber sein, sodass der Kunde einen weiteren Kaffee geniessen kann!

Unsere Devise: 'Go the extra mile!' – Wir tun alles, um unsere Kunden zu begeistern.

## DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

• Besuche selbstständig mit dem Cargo E-Bike unsere Kaffeemaschinen-Standorte bei Firmen in ganz Zürich.

• Knüpfe vor Ort den Kontakt zu unseren Kunden und reagiere aufmerksam auf Fragen sowie Feedback.

• Führe gründliche Reinigungen der Gavetti Kaffeemaschinen durch und stelle die Einhaltung sämtlicher Hygienerichtlinien sicher.

• Befülle regelmässig Kaffeebohnen, Tee, Zucker sowie Milch und tausche diese bei Bedarf aus.

• Entsorge kompostierbare Kaffeesatzsäcke ordnungsgemäss im Lager.

• Dokumentiere alle Arbeitsschritte zuverlässig per Auslieferungs-App, Produktscans und Fotos.

• Stelle im Lager benötigte Materialien zusammen und belade das Cargo E-Bike für deine tägliche Tour (Arbeitszeit ca. 15:00 bis 20:00/21:00 Uhr).

## WAS DICH ERWARTET

Dein Arbeitstag beginnt normalerweise gegen 15.00 Uhr. Zuerst stellst du im Lager die benötigten Materialien für deine Tour zusammen und belädst das Cargo E-Bike. Nach kompletter Befüllung fährst du zu den vorab festgelegten Unternehmen und führst vor Ort den Service sowie das dazugehörige Reporting durch. Eine Tour dauert in der Regel bis ungefähr 20.00 oder 21.00 Uhr.
Du arbeitest selbstständig. Während deiner Arbeitszeit stehst du bei Bedarf telefonisch oder über unser Messaging-System mit dem Dispatcher-Team in Kontakt.

## WAS DU MITBRINGST

• Erfahrung im Service oder in der Food-Delivery Branche mit regelmässigem Kundenkontakt ist ein Plus.

• Herzliche Ausstrahlung: Du 'verkaufst' Customer Happiness - dies startet jeweils mit einem herzlichen Lächeln bei FELFEL.

• Velofahren ist dein Ding : Du liebst es, auf zwei Rädern durch die Stadt zu cruisen, und bleibst dabei bei jedem Wetter sicher und gut gelaunt.

• Du liebst guten Kaffee, probierst gerne Neues aus und teilst dein Wissen mit Begeisterung. ;-)

• Komplette Verlässlichkeit und Selbständigkeit , Sorge zum Detail, präzise Arbeitsweise

• Du zeigst Eigeninitiative und verfügst über gesunden Menschenverstand.

• Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

• Nichtraucher: Du riechst nicht nach Zigaretten und rauchst während der Arbeitszeit nicht. FELFEL steht für eine gesunde Lebensweise.

• EU/EFTA oder Schweizer Arbeitsbewilligung.

## WAS WIR BIETEN

• CHF 25/Stunde

• Regelmässige Einsätze (SO-FR)

• Arbeitskleidung, um für jedes Wetter ausgestattet zu sein.

• Technische Ausstattung für die Arbeitszeit (Handy, Tablet etc.)

• Einblick in die Bereiche Operations, Customer Excellence, Sales und Sustainability eines Food-Tech Unternehmens

• Internes Customer Excellence und Barista Training

• Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an und ein hohes Mass an Selbstständigkeit

• Velo-Touren in Züri ;-)

## BIST DU UNSER ZUKÜNFTIGES TALENT?

Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für Kaffee hast, Kundenkontakt nicht scheust und gerne auf dem Velo unterwegs bist, dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem CV und einem kurzen Anschreiben.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung:)

## IN BREAKDOW

Ti piace navigare attraverso la città su due ruote e fornire alla gente buon caffè per la giornata? Come corriere Gavetti Velo (da oggi 60%) a Zurigo, siete il volto di FELFEL in loco e assicuratevi indipendentemente che i nostri clienti aziendali sperimentino il caffè perfetto ogni giorno.

Si sta visitando ca. 7-8 clienti aziendali al giorno, vedere se tutto è i.O. con il Gavetti (macchina di caffè), riempire i materiali necessari come latte, chicchi di caffè, tè e zucchero. Inoltre, si effettua una pulizia su ogni macchina e mentre lo fa, si risponde al feedback dei clienti. Dopo la vostra visita, i Gavetti dovrebbero essere accoglienti e puliti in modo che il cliente possa gustare un altro caffè!

Il nostro motto: 'Go the extra mile!' Facciamo tutto il possibile per ispirare i nostri clienti.

## Le tue responsabilità

• Visitate le nostre sedi di macchine da caffè indipendentemente con l'e-bike Cargo nelle aziende di tutta Zurigo.

• Contatta i nostri clienti in loco e risponde con attenzione alle domande e ai feedback.

• Eseguire una pulizia approfondita delle macchine da caffè Gavetti e garantire il rispetto di tutte le linee guida per l'igiene.

• Riempire regolarmente chicchi di caffè, tè, zucchero e latte e sostituirli come necessario.

• Smalto di sacchi di caffè compostabili in modo corretto nel magazzino.

• Documenta tutti i passaggi di lavoro in modo affidabile tramite app di consegna, scansioni di prodotto e foto.

• Raccogliere materiali necessari nel magazzino e caricare l'e-bike Cargo per il vostro tour giornaliero (ore lavorative circa 15:00-20:00 / 21:00).

## Cosa aspettate

La tua giornata lavorativa di solito inizia intorno alle 15. In primo luogo avete messo insieme i materiali necessari per il vostro tour nel magazzino e caricare il carico e-bike. Dopo il riempimento completo, si guida alle aziende predefinite e eseguire il servizio e la corrispondente segnalazione sul sito. Un tour dura solitamente fino alle 20 o alle 21.
Lavori in modo indipendente. Durante il vostro orario di lavoro, sarete in contatto con il team di Dispatcher per telefono o tramite il nostro sistema di messaggistica, se necessario.

## Cosa porti

• L'esperienza nel settore del servizio o della consegna di cibo con il contatto cliente regolare è un plus.

• Carisma cordiale: "Sell" La felicità del cliente - questo inizia con un sorriso sentito a FELFEL.

• Il ciclismo è la tua cosa: ti piace attraversare la città su due ruote, rimanendo al sicuro e di buon umore in qualsiasi tempo.

• Amate il buon caffè, come provare cose nuove e condividere la vostra conoscenza con entusiasmo.

• Affidabilità e indipendenza completa, cura dei dettagli, metodi di lavoro precisi

• Lei mostra iniziativa e ha buon senso.

• Lingue: Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese

• Non fumatori: Non si puzzano di sigarette e non si fumano durante le ore di lavoro. FELFEL sta per uno stile di vita sano.

• Permesso di lavoro UE/AELS o Svizzera.

## Cosa offriamo

• CHF 25/ora

• Operazioni regolari (SO-FR)

• Vestiti da lavoro da equipaggiare per qualsiasi tempo.

• Attrezzature tecniche per ore di lavoro (cellulare, tablet, ecc.)

• Insight nei settori delle operazioni, dell'eccellenza del cliente, delle vendite e della sostenibilità di un'azienda food-tech

• Eccellenza e formazione dei clienti interni e Barista

• Responsabilità dal primo giorno e un alto grado di indipendenza

• Velo tour a Züri ;-

## Sei il nostro futuro talento?

Se hai una passione per il caffè, non allontanarti dal contatto con il cliente e ti piace andare in bici, applica ora con il tuo CV e una breve lettera di copertura.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione:

## IN BREAKDOWN

Do you love cruising through the city on two wheels and providing people with good coffee for the day? As a Gavetti Velo courier (from now on, 60%) in Zurich, you are the face of FELFEL on site and independently ensure that our corporate customers experience perfect coffee every day.

You are visiting ca. 7-8 corporate customers a day, see if everything is i.O. with the Gavetti (coffee machine), fill up the necessary materials such as milk, coffee beans, tea and sugar. In addition, you carry out a cleaning on each machine and while doing so, you respond to customer feedback. After your visit, the Gavetti should be welcoming and clean so that the customer can enjoy another coffee!

Our motto: 'Go the extra mile!' We do everything we can to inspire our customers.

## Your responsibilities

• Visit our coffee machine locations independently with the Cargo e-bike at companies throughout Zurich.

• Contact our customers on site and respond attentively to questions and feedback.

• Perform thorough cleaning of Gavetti coffee machines and ensure compliance with all hygiene guidelines.

• Regularly fill coffee beans, tea, sugar and milk and replace them as needed.

• Dispose of compostable coffee ground bags properly in the warehouse.

• Document all work steps reliably via delivery app, product scans and photos.

• Collect materials needed in the warehouse and load the Cargo e-bike for your daily tour (working hours around 15:00 to 20:00 / 21:00).

## What You Expect

Your working day usually starts around 3 p.m. First you put together the necessary materials for your tour in the warehouse and load the cargo e-bike. After complete filling, you drive to the predefined companies and carry out the service and the corresponding reporting on site. A tour usually lasts until about 8 pm or 9 pm.
You work independently. During your working hours, you will be in contact with the Dispatcher team by phone or via our messaging system if necessary.

## What you bring

• Experience in the service or food delivery industry with regular customer contact is a plus.

• Heartfelt charisma: You 'sell' Customer happiness - this starts with a heartfelt smile at FELFEL.

• Cycling is your thing: you love to cruise through the city on two wheels, while staying safe and in a good mood in any weather.

• You love good coffee, like to try new things and share your knowledge with enthusiasm. ;-

• Complete reliability and independence, care for detail, precise working methods

• You show initiative and have common sense.

• Languages: Very good knowledge of German and English

• Non-smokers: You do not smell of cigarettes and do not smoke during working hours. FELFEL stands for a healthy lifestyle.

• EU/EFTA or Swiss work permit.

## What we offer

• CHF 25/hour

• Regular operations (SO-FR)

• Work clothes to be equipped for any weather.

• Technical equipment for working hours (mobile phone, tablet, etc.)

• Insight into the areas of operations, customer excellence, sales and sustainability of a food-tech company

• Internal Customer Excellence and Barista Training

• Responsibility from day one and a high degree of independence

• Velo tours in Züri ;-

## Are you our future talent?

If you have a passion for coffee, don’t shy away from customer contact and like to go on the bike, apply now with your CV and a short cover letter.

We look forward to your application:

## À VENIR

Aimez-vous la croisière à travers la ville sur deux roues et fournir aux gens un bon café pour la journée? En tant que messager Gavetti Velo (à partir de maintenant, 60%) à Zurich, vous êtes le visage de FELFEL sur place et vous assurez indépendamment que nos clients d'entreprise vivent un café parfait chaque jour.

Vous visitez environ 7-8 entreprises clients par jour, voir si tout est i.O. avec le Gavetti (machine à café), remplir les matériaux nécessaires tels que le lait, les grains de café, le thé et le sucre. En outre, vous effectuez un nettoyage sur chaque machine et tout en le faisant, vous répondez aux commentaires des clients. Après votre visite, le Gavetti devrait être accueillant et propre afin que le client puisse profiter d'un autre café!

Notre devise: 'Allez au mille supplémentaire!' Nous faisons tout notre possible pour inspirer nos clients.

## Vos responsabilités

• Visitez notre machine à café en toute indépendance avec le Cargo e-bike dans les entreprises de Zurich.

• Contactez nos clients sur place et répondez attentivement aux questions et aux commentaires.

• Effectuer un nettoyage complet des machines à café Gavetti et assurer le respect de toutes les règles d'hygiène.

• Remplir régulièrement les grains de café, le thé, le sucre et le lait et les remplacer au besoin.

• Jetez les sacs de café compostables correctement dans l'entrepôt.

• Documentez toutes les étapes de travail de manière fiable via l'application de livraison, les analyses de produits et les photos.

• Recueillir le matériel nécessaire dans l'entrepôt et charger l'e-bike Cargo pour votre visite quotidienne (heures de travail autour de 15:00 à 20:00 / 21:00).

## Ce que vous attendez

Votre journée de travail commence généralement vers 15 heures. D'abord, vous avez mis en place les matériaux nécessaires pour votre visite dans l'entrepôt et chargez l'e-bike cargo. Après le remplissage complet, vous conduisez vers les entreprises prédéfinies et effectuez le service et les rapports correspondants sur le site. Une visite dure généralement jusqu'à 20h ou 21h.
Vous travaillez indépendamment. Pendant vos heures de travail, vous serez en contact avec l'équipe du régulateur par téléphone ou via notre système de messagerie si nécessaire.

## Ce que vous apportez

• L'expérience dans l'industrie du service ou de la livraison des aliments avec des contacts réguliers avec les clients est un plus.

• Charisme de cœur : Vous « vendez » le bonheur du client - cela commence par un sourire sincère à FELFEL.

• Le vélo est votre truc : vous aimez faire une croisière à travers la ville sur deux roues, tout en restant en sécurité et de bonne humeur par tous les temps.

• Vous aimez le bon café, comme essayer de nouvelles choses et partager vos connaissances avec enthousiasme. ;-

• Fiabilité et indépendance complètes, soin du détail, méthodes de travail précises

• Vous montrez de l'initiative et avez du bon sens.

• Langues: Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais

• Non-fumeurs: Vous ne sentez pas de cigarettes et ne fumez pas pendant les heures de travail. FELFEL représente un mode de vie sain.

• Permis de travail UE/AELE ou Suisse.

## Ce que nous offrons

• CHF 25/heure

• Opérations régulières (SO-FR)

• Vêtements de travail à équiper pour n'importe quel temps.

• Matériel technique pour les heures de travail (téléphone mobile, tablette, etc.)

• Regard sur les domaines d'activité, l'excellence client, les ventes et la durabilité d'une entreprise de technologie alimentaire

• Excellence client interne et formation Barista

• Responsabilité dès le premier jour et degré élevé d'indépendance

• Tours Velo à Züri ;-

## Êtes-vous notre futur talent ?

Si vous avez une passion pour le café, ne soyez pas à l'écart du contact client et aimez aller sur la moto, appliquez maintenant avec votre CV et une courte lettre de motivation.

Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature :

jobs.description:
## IN KÜRZE

Der Mix aus Software und Technik ist genau dein Ding und du liebst es, selbstständig in der ganzen Schweiz unterwegs zu sein? Als Servicetechniker*in (ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung, 80-100%) in Zürich Wiedikon bringst du frischen Wind in die Büros der Schweiz und wirst Teil unseres engagierten Hardware Teams.

## DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

• Unterstütze dein Team bei der Erfüllung aller Hardware-Aufgaben unter der Woche – ohne Picket- oder Wochenendeinsätze.

• Installiere unsere FELFEL Kühlschränke und Gavetti Kaffeemaschinen direkt beim Kunden vor Ort.

• Koordiniere deine Einsätze eng mit dem Implementation Team, um reibungslose Installationen zu garantieren.

• Führe regelmässige Wartungs- und Unterhaltsarbeiten an unseren Systemen in der ganzen Schweiz durch.

• Übernimm Reparaturarbeiten beim Kunden und gestalte deinen Tagesablauf flexibel.

• Führe vielseitige Montagearbeiten in unserer Werkstatt in Zürich aus.

• Arbeite flexibel im Zweierteam, in der Werkstatt oder eigenverantwortlich "on the road".
 Die Montage und Wartung von FELFEL und Gavetti ist eine spannende Mischung aus Elektronik, Mechanik, Schreinerarbeit, Software und Technik. Entsprechend ist die Rolle sehr abwechslungsreich und das Team interdisziplinär, mit der Möglichkeit sich in verschiedenen Bereichen weiter zu entwickeln.

## WAS DU MITBRINGST

Das Hardware-Team ist sehr interdisziplinär und es gibt viele interne Schulungen. Folgende Hintergründe sind von Vorteil:

• Mechaniker, Schreiner oder in einem vergleichbaren technischen Beruf.

• Vielseitige Begabung an der Schnittstelle von Elektronik, Mechanik, Schreinerarbeit und Software.

• Hohe Flexibilität, Selbstständigkeit und Freude am Reisen innerhalb der Schweiz.

• Grosse Leidenschaft sowohl für die praktische, hands-on Arbeit an der Werkbank als auch für das präzise Verfassen von technischen Standards.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch.

• Pflicht: Gültiger Schweizer Führerausweis (Kategorie B).

• Nichtraucher*in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riechst, weder bei der Arbeit noch bei Kundenmeetings. Schliesslich dreht sich bei FELFEL alles um gutes Essen.

• Gültige Arbeitsbewilligung für die Schweiz oder Schweizer Pass.

## WAS WIR BIETEN

• Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...

• Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine

• 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr, und die Möglichkeit, eine extra Woche zu erwerben

• Wir denken an deine Zukunft und bieten eine überobligatorische Pensionskassenlösung

• Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten

• Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV

• Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings

• Bleib in Bewegung und gesund mit unseren wöchentlichen Sportkursen

Klingt das nach dem perfekten Job für dich? Wir können es kaum erwarten, mehr über dich zu erfahren! BEWIRB DICH JETZT mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen auf Deutsch oder Englisch.

jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Are you a tech-savvy problem solver ready to modernize an expanding IT landscape? As our new IT & Automation Operations Manager (80–100%) in Zurich Wiedikon, you will be right at the heart of our tech evolution. Working within our lean, dynamic Business Technology Solutions team, you will drive the consolidation of our systems and prepare FELFEL for seamless international scale.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
 Strategic Transformation (40%)

• Drive the migration from overlapping platforms (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Dropbox) into one unified, modern workplace ecosystem to support hybrid work and international expansion.

• Analyze, redefine, and execute scalable IT processes to elevate internal service levels without increasing headcount.

• Rationalize and simplify our SaaS landscape and optimize software licenses to reduce IT costs by 30–50%.

• Build, scale, and govern automation workflows across IT and business processes while supporting our motivated citizen developers.
 Operational Excellence (50%)

• Manage end-user computing, device lifecycles, and workplace technology, including laptops, mobile devices, and meeting rooms.

• Implement and improve Identity & Access Management (IAM), including SSO, MFA, and automated user provisioning and deprovisioning.

• Elevate our ITIL-based service management framework to ensure rapid internal support, clear SLAs, and high user satisfaction.

• Standardize processes, maintain data hygiene, and automate workflows across core business systems like ERP, HR, and finance tools.

• Consolidate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and manage software licenses while ensuring data protection and audit readiness.

• Deploy self-service IT solutions and document core processes to maximize team productivity and eliminate single points of failure.
 Business Partnership (10%)

• Partner with department heads to proactively identify and address business technology needs.

• Lead organizational change initiatives to ensure the smooth adoption of new tools and processes across the company.

• Collaborate closely with the engineering and platform teams on authentication, integrations, and shared services.

• Evaluate and pilot innovative digital tools that drive operational efficiency.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 5–7 years of experience in IT or technology operations, with a proven track record of driving platform migrations and SaaS consolidations.

• Background working in fast-growing scale-ups or SMEs (100–500 employees), ideally within retail, logistics, or food service.

• Deep technical expertise in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration, migration, and optimization.

• Hands-on experience with Identity Management solutions (Azure AD, Google Cloud Identity, Okta) and MDM platforms (Kandji, JAMF, Rippling, Intune).

• Proficiency in business process automation tools such as n8n, PowerAutomate, or Zapier.

• Strong understanding of data protection, access controls, and compliance requirements for core business applications.

• High degree of ownership and autonomy, with the ability to make independent day-to-day decisions and balance operational needs with long-term strategic goals.

• Creative problem-solving skills and a proven ability to act as a change agent with limited resources.

• Collaborative mindset with a passion for supporting and consulting the wider organization within a lean team structure.

• Excellent professional communication skills in English and German; French is a strong plus.

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

If this sounds like the job for you, then APPLY NOW with your complete application documents in English or German. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US
 FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality.

With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

www.felfel.ch

jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Are you ready to build the backbone of our smart workplace technology? As our new IoT Platform Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will own the transition of our hardware fleet into a highly reliable, streamlined system. FELFEL puts smart fridges and coffee machines in offices across Switzerland and the US, and every line of code you write will run in a real workplace, serving real people every day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the device runtime on our fridges and coffee machine controllers (Gavettis) end to end, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.

• Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single platform, making the architectural choices and defending them.

• Reduce the number of programming languages running on the edge, bringing our cloud and device environments closer together.

• Partner with the Head of Engineering to spec the next generation of fridge and Gavetti hardware, pick vendors, and define the software contracts.

• Manage and evolve vendor relationships and integrations for our vendors and badge reader suppliers.

• Act as the ultimate reality check on the engineering team for what is actually running and succeeding in the field.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 5+ years of experience building production systems, with a proven track record of shipping and operating a real fleet of devices in production (handling real users, outages, and OTA updates).

• Strong working knowledge of edge platform concerns, including networking (VPNs, NAT, flaky links), Linux and Android on small hardware, OS-level debugging, and observability for offline-tolerant systems.

• Comfort and proficiency across at least two of the following languages: C#, Go, or Kotlin, with a willingness to standardize.

• Deep understanding of hardware as an interface, with the ability to navigate Modbus, USB, serial connections, sensor datasheets, and vendor SDKs.

• Experience with Balena, Azure IoT Hub, KubeEdge, Kubernetes, Docker, or containerized workloads is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with commercial appliance ecosystems (like coffee machines or vending) and enough electronics literacy to read a datasheet and ask the right questions.

• Pragmatic problem-solving mindset—you would rather standardize than invent, and you choose the boring, reliable tool over the purely interesting one.

• Fluency in English, German is nice to have

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US
 FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality.
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

www.felfel.ch

FELFEL VALUES

jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Are you ready to own the edge runtime for thousands of smart fridges and coffee machines across Switzerland and the US? As our new Fleet & Device Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will join a close-knit 8-person engineering team to rebuild and manage the systems that power our hardware. In this hybrid role, you will take full ownership of our edge domain from day one, ensuring that our unglamorous but highly reliable hardware works seamlessly for real people getting their lunch every day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Take full, end-to-end ownership of the edge runtime on our smart fridges and Gavetti coffee machine controllers, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.

• Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single, reliable platform (such as Azure IoT Hub or KubeEdge), taking charge of making and defending the architectural choices.

• Streamline the technology stack by reducing the number of languages running on the edge, bringing the device world closer to our cloud environment.

• Collaborate closely with and report directly to the Head of Engineering to specify the next generation of hardware, select vendors, and define software contracts.

• Inherit and manage crucial vendor relationships and integrations, including those for our vendors and various badge reader suppliers.

• Ensure the team maintains a grounded, honest understanding of what is actually running and performing in the field.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• Solid background with roughly 5+ years of experience building and operating production systems, specifically managing a real fleet of devices with live users, outages, and OTA updates.

• Proficiency in at least two of the following languages: C#, Go, or Kotlin, coupled with a willingness to consolidate and standardize our tech stack.

• Working knowledge of edge platform networking (VPNs, NAT, flaky links, office networks), running Linux and Android on small hardware, OS-level debugging, and observability for offline-tolerant systems.

• Strong ability to treat hardware as an interface, including practical experience with Modbus, USB, serial connections, reading sensor datasheets, and working with vendor SDKs.

• Familiarity with tools like Balena, Azure IoT Hub, KubeEdge, Kubernetes, Docker, or experience in commercial appliance ecosystems is a strong plus.

• Pragmatic problem-solving mindset with a track record of putting the problem before the programming language, preferring standard, reliable tools over inventing custom solutions.

• Fluency in English, German is nice to have

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US
 FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality.
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

www.felfel.ch

NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Do you enjoy variety, working independently and being on the move? Are you equally happy cycling through Lausanne, driving to customers in the surrounding region and making sure every location looks clean, welcoming and ready to use?

As our Field Service Allrounder, no two days are exactly the same. On some days, you will complete a Gavetti coffee tour through Lausanne with one of our cargo e-bikes. On other days, you will travel by car or van to corporate customers located further away and take care of their FELFEL fridges and Gavetti coffee machines.

Wherever your route takes you, your goal stays the same: to make sure everything runs smoothly and our customers receive the best possible service.

Our team motto: Go the extra mile and do everything possible to make our customers happy. :)

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Follow daily routes planned by our Dispatcher Team to visit corporate customers in Lausanne and the surrounding area.

• Drive cargo e-bikes, cars, or small vans depending on your assigned route.

• Clean and inspect FELFEL fridges and restock Gavetti coffee machines to maintain high quality standards.

• Ensure all equipment and surrounding areas meet strict hygiene and presentation requirements.

• Refill essential products and materials, including coffee beans, milk, tea, sugar, cutlery, and utensils.

• Collect recycling materials and return them to the warehouse or local recycling partner.

• Engage warmly with customers, answering questions and gathering feedback on-site.

• Document every visit accurately by scanning products, taking photos, and updating information via our mobile apps.

WHAT TO EXPECT
 Your daily schedule depends on the route you are assigned. Both shifts start at our Lausanne office in Bel-Air.

On a bike-tour day, you arrive at the office around 3 pm. You prepare the required materials, load your cargo e-bike and start your planned route. You normally visit around seven corporate customers per shift. At each location, you clean and restock the Gavetti coffee machine, check the surrounding area and document your visit in our app. Your working day usually ends between 8 and 9 pm.

*Monday is different: the first bike tour starts at 5 am All other bike tours follow the regular afternoon schedule.

On a Merchant day, you travel by car to customers across the French-speaking part of Switzerland and take care of FELFEL fridges, Gavetti coffee machines or both. These shifts normally take place during regular working hours, approximately from 8am to 5pm.

During every shift, you work independently. However, our Dispatcher Team is always available by phone or message if you have questions or need support.

• Previous experience in service, customer care, or a similar hospitality-driven industry is a plus.

• Valid Category B driver's license with confidence riding cargo e-bikes and navigating larger cars or small vans.

• High degree of reliability, independence, attention to detail, and a precise working style.

• Warm, positive personality with a strong commitment to delivering exceptional Customer Happiness.

• Strong initiative, practical common sense, and availability to work at least two full days per week (including early morning or evening shifts).

• Fluency in both French and English is required.

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 As a Business Development Manager (100%) in Zurich, you become the trusted host for a portfolio of clients: the person who makes sure their FELFEL experience keeps getting better, from their very first weeks with us all the way to renewal. You'll build real relationships, spot what each client needs before they ask, and turn happy customers into long-term partners.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own and manage a large portfolio of clients from post trial engagement to renewal.

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key contacts to manage expectations and overall satisfaction and retention.

• Analyze client needs continuously to optimize their experience and pinpoint cross-sell or upsell opportunities.

• Drive organic growth actively within your segment to maximize account potential and business value.

• Engage proactively with clients flagged during health checks and monitor key metrics to prevent churn proactively.

• Lead account reviews, contract negotiations, and renewals with confidence and care.

• Work hand in hand with our Acquisition, Product, Operations, and Support teams so every client gets one seamless FELFEL experience.

• Bring what you hear from clients back inside, so we keep making our food and service better.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 3–5 years in account management, client success, or a similar customer-facing role.

• Proven track record of efficiently managing and growing a large, diverse client portfolio.

• Confidence with CRM tools (Hubspot) to keep your work organized and your clients well looked after.

• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset that combines a sales instinct with a real sense of hospitality — you spot opportunities to grow accounts while genuinely taking care of people.

• Excellent communication skills and the ease to connect with everyone from an office manager to a CEO.

• Energy for a fast-paced environment, paired with the patience to build relationships that last.

• Fluent German and proficient in English.

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

• Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

• Churn Rate

• Portfolio Growth (Cross-sell/Upsell)

• Client Health Score

• Customer Satisfaction (CSAT or NPS)

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

If this sounds like the perfect role for you, please submit your CV & complete documents (references, diplomas) in German or English!

APPLY NOW

 FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality.
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

 As an Account Manager (100%) in Zurich, you become the trusted host for a portfolio of clients: the person who makes sure their FELFEL experience keeps getting better, from their very first weeks with us all the way to renewal. NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
As an Account Manager (100%) in Zurich, you become the trusted host for a portfolio of clients: the person who makes sure their FELFEL experience keeps getting better, from their very first weeks with us all the way to renewal. You'll build real relationships, spot what each client needs before they ask, and turn happy customers into long-term partners.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own and manage a large portfolio of clients from post trial engagement to renewal.

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key contacts to manage expectations and overall satisfaction and retention.

• Analyze client needs continuously to optimize their experience and pinpoint cross-sell or upsell opportunities.

• Drive organic growth actively within your segment to maximize account potential and business value.

• Engage proactively with clients flagged during health checks and monitor key metrics to prevent churn proactively.

• Lead account reviews, contract negotiations, and renewals with confidence and care.

• Work hand in hand with our Acquisition, Product, Operations, and Support teams so every client gets one seamless FELFEL experience.

• Bring what you hear from clients back inside, so we keep making our food and service better.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 3–5 years in account management, client success, or a similar customer-facing role.

• Proven track record of efficiently managing and growing a large, diverse client portfolio.

• Confidence with CRM tools (Hubspot) to keep your work organized and your clients well looked after.

• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset that combines a sales instinct with a real sense of hospitality — you spot opportunities to grow accounts while genuinely taking care of people.

• Excellent communication skills and the ease to connect with everyone from an office manager to a CEO.

• Energy for a fast-paced environment, paired with the patience to build relationships that last.

• Fluent German and proficient in English.

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

• Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

• Churn Rate

• Portfolio Growth (Cross-sell/Upsell)

• Client Health Score

• Customer Satisfaction (CSAT or NPS)

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Ready to apply? If this sounds like the perfect role for you, please submit (German or English):
• Your CV & complete documents (references, diplomas)

• A short video introducing yourself and telling us why you are our next Account Manager (max. 1 minute)

APPLY NOW
